# @k8ordo/state

> Declare state by where it lives. One zod schema defines a page's URL search
> params: the server parses them typed, links serialize canonically (defaults
> omitted), and the client subscribes over the Navigation API with exact
> per-key change detection. Works through links and GET forms before
> JavaScript loads; imperative updates ride a Navigation-API-intercepting
> router.
>
> Like every k8ordo package it assumes React 19 and Server Components, uses
> only what has reached Baseline newly available, and ships no polyfills or
> legacy fallbacks.

When installed via npm, these docs live under `node_modules/@k8ordo/state/docs/`.

## Guide

- [Design Guide](GUIDE.md): the shared definition module, reading on the
  server, updating on the client, batching and update handles, subscription
  granularity, router requirements, typed routes via `Register`, and pairing
  with `@k8ordo/form` for GET forms.

## Entry point

- `@k8ordo/state` — `definePageState(key, { url: schema })` returns a pure
  definition usable from server and client: `parseUrl(searchParams)` reads
  typed values with defaults applied and per-field salvage of broken params;
  `href(base, values?)` builds a canonical link keeping the path literal in
  the type; `search(values?)` returns the query string alone.
  `useAppState(definition, keys?, { initialUrl? })` (client) returns
  `[state, update]` — `update(patch, { history? })` applies synchronously,
  batches per handler into one `navigation.navigate()`, and returns
  `{ committed, finished }` promise handles. `resetStateRegistry()` clears
  stores between tests. Augment `interface Register { path }` to constrain
  `href` paths to the app's typed routes.
